title: Hawking's 1974 argument for black-hole radiation
summary: Hawking's Nature paper argues that black holes radiate. That radiation has not been the same kind of detection as LIGO or the EHT.
body: S. W. Hawking, "Black hole explosions?" (Nature, 1974), argued that black holes emit radiation and can lose mass. The v1 article calls Hawking radiation a theoretical prediction from 1974. That label is right: the paper is a theoretical argument. This pack does not cite a detection of Hawking radiation from an astrophysical black hole. Evidence for the published argument is strong; evidence that the radiation has been seen is not established on this card.
